description: Dehya Durin Emilie Nicole. 20s rot. Durin on-field with 4 or 5 N1CD and Dehya field time after that. Emilie Q every 2 rots. Battery order of Nicole > Durin > Dehya. Team DPS of Durin ~43%, Emilie ~34%, and Dehya ~20%.

Alhatiham hyperbloom for new players. When Alhatiham bursts, ensure you swap back very quickly. Do 3 normal attacks then dash/skill/charge attack in this pattern: N3d N3E, N3d N3C, N3d N3 end of combo
Kazuha Mona Durin Ineffa. Tf kazuha in 2t. Accommodates for kazuha cons; c6 kazuha is ~4k dps/target more. VV kazuha is ~9k dps/target more, but less fun.

C1 Dehya Bennett Furina Skirk. ~20s rot. Skirk hE twice and Q once. Skirk deals more DPS than Dehya despite not Melting anything from her Q. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. GT on Furina + HP% Goblet is ~400 less DPS. C0 Dehya loses ~4.5k DPS.

⏭️🔄 Mavuika Citlali Xilonen Nicole. 17-19s rot. hE C1 Q C1F and [D*C1F] spam. Citlali Q every 2rots w/ zero ER. Xilonen can use 4pc Instructor, see the config. Talent Level 10,10,10. 📢 UPDATED after v2.44.2(2026/08/18) Citlali fix release
Hu Tao Furina Yelan Citlali. All C6R5. 11N2CD. Talent Level 10/10/10. Hutao Start HP=60%. Freeze immunity loses a massive 52k~ DPS.
Fischl Yelan Zhongli Overvape 2ATK 2Pyro
Itto Xilonen with Yelan Xingqiu. Itto ER reqs are likely to match existing builds thanks to Xilonen using 2 skills per rotation, at the cost of team DPS.

Clorinde Durin Chev Nicole. 18s rot. Chev hE Q > Nicole EQ > Durin N1 2[E] Q N2(D N2D N1) setup. use more Durin NAs after his Q when Clorinde doesn't use her Q in that rot. All of Nicole's Arcane Projection procs are consumed by Durin and Clorinde. Clorinde is ~55% Team DPS share
Fischl Yelan Zhongli Overvape 2EM 2ATK
C6R5 Hutao double hydro with Xilo, 11N2CD. Maximizes Xilo buff uptime, backloads Hutao. TL 10/10/10. Hutao Start HP=50%.

C1 Dehya Bennett Furina Kazuha. 21s rot. Bennett funnels his Skill directly into Dehya's Burst. Kazuha does a Hold Skill during setup. Kazuha casts his Burst and absorbs Pyro at the end of the rotation to allow Furina to Vaporize more hits. Pyro VV is inconsistent but can be improved with C6 Bennett. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. Scroll on Bennett is ~400 more DPS. C0 Dehya loses ~6k DPS.
C6R5 Hu Tao double hydro. Doesn't use Furina's C6 for dmg purposes. Talent Level 10,10,10. Hutao start HP = 1.

C1 Dehya Chevreuse Furina Ororon. ~20s rot. Dehya triggers Vaporize and some Overloads. Chevreuse is on a damage build. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. GT on Furina is slightly more DPS but ~1k less Dehya DPS. Chevreuse on a healing build is ~1.2k less DPS in favor of ~600 more Dehya DPS. C0 Dehya loses ~6k DPS.
Fischl Yelan Zhongli Overvape 4RB
Xiao Faruza Nicole Ifa. 21s rotation. Scroll & TTDS bot Ifa doing E [2CA] EP. 12 Xiao plunges with 100% collision assumed. No Nicole Q

Faruzan Durin Bennett Nicole. ~20s Rot, Pseudo APL. Faruzan on-field DPS spends Burst and Hurricane Arrows as available within Bennett burst- no field time is offered to other units within Bennett burst.
Mualani Mona[C4] Prune Mavuika. 18s rotation. Mavuika Q every rotation with 2 field times on Prune and Mona. Mona C2 is 132k DPS. Fav Mona helps Prune ER requirements a lot.
Columbina Lauma Nilou Nahida. All C6R5. 18s rot. Columbina ~6.75 special CAs per rot. Nilou E N3 No Nahida Q Fav Nahida. Talent Level 10,10,10
Lanyan Columbina Durin Ineffa. ~18 Rot. Pseudo-APL. KQMS KurtC. Lanyan Driving Rainbow. 3EM Xiphos Durin and EDC Durin are similar. Hyperoptizing this is probably a waste of your time.
Neuv Furina Citlali Xilonen. All C6R5. Neuv 2E 27s rot. Simply Citlali E, then you get 4Scroll and Sig passive buff. Talent Level 10,10,10

Arlecchino Fischl Durin Chevreuse. Pseudo APL - Chevreuse only casts her abilities when Durin's ready to cast his Q. No Arle Q. N3D combo. Chain Breaker + 4pc GT Fischl is fine at ~2k DPS less. ⚠️ Different duration time can change DPS, roughly ~5-10k range.

Hu Tao overvape for new players. Do Xingqiu stuff before Bennett and remember to attack on Fischl before deploying E or Q so she gets the Bennett buff. Bennett is more useful than Hu Tao's want to stay below 50% hp.
Varesa Durin Chev Nicole. ~18s rot. 6 Plunge Combos. Chev hE N1 > Nicole Q E > Durin 2[E]Q > Varesa.  First rot skips Nicole Q and uses Chev Q before hE to trigger Overloaded.
Itto Xilonen with Furina Mavuika. 2 Xilo Es used to fuel Itto and Mav bursts. Mav uses C1D to fill for Xilo E downtime. Whiteblind R5 outperforms Serpent R1
Neuv Furina Xilonen Kazuha. All C6R5. Neuv 2E 28s rot. Talent Level 10,10,10
Faruzan Jean Durin Nicole. ~20s Rot, Pseudo APL. Faruzan on-field DPS spends Burst and Hurricane Arrows as available within Jean burst. Jean uses skill when Faruzan lacks Hurricane Arrows.
Itto Xilonen Gorou with Bennett. Xilonen C2 is required to keep her buffs active. Energy requirements are greatly eased by Xilonen 2E on the second rotation onwards.
Ifa Faruzan Durin Prune. 19s rotation. Ifa does CA spam with Q every rotation. Scroll Ifa is slightly worse at KQMS.
Ifa Faruzan Durin Nicole. 20s rotation. Carry Ifa doing CA spam and Q every rotation. Codex is slightly worse on Ifa at KQMS. Nicole Q every rotation.
Fischl Yelan Zhongli Overvape 2EM 2Pyro
Kinich Mavuika Durin Nicole. All C6R5. 18s rot. E 5[N2 shE] combo with consistently NA clockwise. Kinich skips his Q entirely. Kinich 69% of Team DPS. Talent Level 10,10,10

Lanyan Columbina Ororon Ineffa. ~18 Rot. Pseudo-APL. KQMS KurtC. Lanyan Driving Lunarcharge. Aubade/SMS barely over SMS/Scroll Columbina & Ororon for team DPS. Hyperoptizing this is probably a waste of your time.

Itto "Lamentto" plunge with Xilonen, Furina, Xianyun. Itto Q E 8DJHP C2F E CF, 50% plunge collision rate. Without C2, Xilonen's source samples do not activate and she only provides energy and 4pc Scroll. Energy requirements are greatly eased by Xilonen 2E on the second rotation onwards.
Columbina Lauma Nilou Nahida. All C6R5. 18s rot. Columbina ~7 special CAs per rot. Nilou E N2 E No Nahida Q. Talent Level 10,10,10

C1 Dehya Bennett Skirk Escoffier. ~21s rot. Skirk hE twice and Q once. Dehya does not Melt. Escoffier casts her Q when it's available. Escoffier uses her abilities outside Bennett's Q and Melts her Skill. Skirk is the highest portion of team DPS and Melts 2 hits of her Q. Hurt triggered every 3-5s. C0 Dehya loses ~2.5k DPS.
Mavuika Citlali Xilonen Nicole. 17-19s rot. 2[C3FD] combo. Citlali Q every 2rots w/ zero ER. Xilonen can use 4pc Instructor, see the config. Talent Level 10,10,10
Clorinde Furina Nahida Xilonen. All C6R5. 32s rot. Clorinde and Furina Q twice, Nahida Q once. Mavuika-less Clorinde having more than 80% of team DPS share. Talent Level 10,10,10
Itto Xilonen with Furina Escoffier. Energy requirements are greatly eased by Xilonen 2E on the second rotation onwards. Escoffier burst used when available.
Lauma Columbina Nilou Nahida. All C6R5 18s rot. Total 6 Lauma hE during 4 rots. Talent Level 10,10,10
Neuv Columbina Lauma Ineffa. All C6R5. Neuv 2E 32s rot. Everyone uses their Burst. Talent Level 10,10,10
Ifa Furina Durin Nicole. 20s rotation. Ifa does CA spam with Q every rotation. Furina Q when available. Nicole does Q every rotation with Pamber.
C6R5 Mavuika Xilonen Nicole Durin, talents 10/10/10, 6[C2D] CD combo. White Durin is ~75k (~6%) higher dps, Nicole burst is a tiny dps gain, Xilonen does N4 instead of N2 for ~15k (~1.2%) higher dps
Hu Tao Yelan Furina Citlali. All C6R5. 20s rot. Hu Tao N2CD and Q every 2 rot. Talent Level 10,10,10
Fischl Yelan Zhongli Overvape 2ATK 2ATK
Itto Xilonen Gorou with Furina. Xilonen C2 is required to keep her buffs active. Healing build on Gorou. Functions well despite Fanfare generation dropping in later rotations.
Neuv Furina Escoffier Citlali. All C6R5. Neuv 2E 25s rot. Escoffier and Citlali simply press their E. Talent Level 10,10,10
Fischl Yelan Zhongli Overvape 2NA 2Pyro
